baslangic.aciklama: Close the app and open it again.

gun.ipucu_1: A rolled wrap is not served until it is papered.
gun.ipucu_2: A burnt skewer holds its slot until it is binned.
gun.ipucu_3: Gold on the ledge is swept in ten seconds, and 30% of it goes.
gun.ipucu_4: Ingredients do not wait for the meat: the bread is enough.
gun.ipucu_5: The higher the tempo, the more everything pays.
gun.ipucu_6: Leave the grill empty and the mince tray starts blinking.

olay.altin_supuruldu: 30% of the gold got swept up

ozet.reklam_alt: Double the takings with a short video
ozet.hazir: The orders are in — get back to the counter!

hosgeldin.1: Welcome, usta. From today it is on you.
hosgeldin.2: Bread on the wrap station, mince on the grill. Cooked meat goes on the bread.
hosgeldin.3: Then flick up to roll it, add the paper, and hand it over.

tempo.1: The dial above the grill is tempo. Every right move lifts it, every wrong one drops it.
tempo.2: The higher it runs the more everything pays. Let it go cold and you work at half price.

altin.1: Customers leave their money on the counter. Untouched, it is swept in ten seconds.
altin.2: Sweeping costs you 30% of it. Reaching for it costs nothing.

gidis.1: Every day has a shape: the rush arrives, passes, and sometimes comes back.
gidis.2: The card tells you which. Get ahead during the quiet stretches.

porsiyon.1: The plate line is open. Bread first, then meat — no rolling, no paper.
porsiyon.2: Components pay extra; putting one on somebody who said no does not.

icecek.1: Take a glass off the shelf and bring the jug to it. Filling takes a moment.
icecek.2: Cola comes from the bottle and waits for nothing.
